name: Titanium.UI.DashboardView
summary:
A dashboard view is an iOS Springboard-like view of [Titanium.UI.DashboardItem](api:Titanium.UI.DashboardItem) items that may 
be deleted and reordered by the user using its built-in edit mode.
description:
The DashboardView is created using the [Titanium.UI.createDashboardView](api:Titanium.UI#createDashboardView) method or **`<DashboardView>`** 
Alloy element.

Dashboard view's edit mode may be activated by a longpress of a [Titanium.UI.DashboardItem](api:Titanium.UI.DashboardItem) item, 
unless this behavior has been disabled by the [editable](api:Titanium.UI.DashboardView#editable) 
property. As a dashboard view does not inherently provide a way to exit edit mode, this must be 
explicitly defined.

When edit mode has been activated, the item icons wobble by default to act as a visual cue. 
This behavior may be disabled using the [wobble](api:Titanium.UI.DashboardView#wobble) property.

If a dashboard contains more than 9 items, it will be paged into screens in a 3 x 3 formation 
using its built-in scrollable view. A paging control is added to the bottom of the view to 
indicate the active page.

Note that a dashboard is only intended to be used in [PORTRAIT](api:Titanium.UI#PORTRAIT) 
orientation mode.

Alloy XML Markup

properties.name: columnCount
properties.summary: The number of columns of items in the view.

properties.name: data
properties.summary: Items to display in this view.

properties.name: editable
properties.summary: Determines whether edit mode is activated by a longpress of an item.
properties.description: Set to `false` to prevent a longpress from activating edit mode.

properties.name: rowCount
properties.summary: The number of rows of items in the view.

properties.name: wobble
properties.summary: Determines whether the wobble visual editing cue is enabled in edit mode.
properties.description:
Set to `false` to disable wobble effect.

Must be defined before edit mode is activated in order to take effect.

methods.name: startEditing
methods.description: This method causes the [Titanium.UI.DashboardView.edit](api:Titanium.UI.DashboardView#edit) event to fire.

methods.name: stopEditing
methods.description: This method causes the [Titanium.UI.DashboardView.commit](api:Titanium.UI.DashboardView#commit) event to fire.

properties.name: location
properties.summary: Coordinates x and y of the event from the parent view's coordinate system.

events.name: commit
events.description: This event is invoked by the [Titanium.UI.DashboardView.stopEditing](api:Titanium.UI.DashboardView#stopEditing) method.

events.name: delete
events.summary: Fired when an item is deleted in edit mode.

events.name: dragend
events.summary: Fired when an item finishes being dragged in edit mode.

events.name: dragstart
events.summary: Fired when an item starts being dragged in edit mode.

events.name: edit
events.description:
This event is invoked by a longpress of a [Titanium.UI.DashboardItem](api:Titanium.UI.DashboardItem) item or the 
[Titanium.UI.DashboardView.startEditing](api:Titanium.UI.DashboardView#startEditing) method.

events.name: move
events.summary: Fired when an item is moved in edit mode.

properties.name: items
properties.summary: List of items to be committed, possibly in new order, when edit mode ends.

events.name: pagechanged
events.summary: Fired when the current page of the dashboard view changes.
